contents.name: 3.1 Definition of the integral and basic properties
3.2 Integrals and limits
contents.reason: This source section is about integral limits and convergence machinery, not a new PT-1 theorem family. The design places those expectation-limit consequences on PT-4, where the convergence modes and their implication diagram are developed together.

contents.name: 3.4 Integration and differentiation
contents.reason: This section is about differentiation under the integral sign and related analytic refinements. PT-1 only needs change of variables, expectation, and the probability-space inequality package, so reproducing the differentiation theory here would add non-load-bearing analysis.

contents.name: Theorem 4.4.2 (Minkowski's inequality)
contents.reason: The PT-1 design stops at Holder, Cauchy-Schwarz, Lyapunov, Markov, and Chebyshev on a probability space. Minkowski is already authored on the measure-theory L^p page and is not a load-bearing probability-page result here.

contents.name: 8.2.4 Fonction generatrice
contents.reason: Probability-generating functions are not load-bearing on this page. The current spine stops at expectation, distribution functions, inequalities, and affine L^2 prediction, while branching-process and renewal uses of generating functions are explicitly outside the commissioned PT-1 scope.

canonical.name: Finite full-power-set probability measures recover exactly the published finite probability spaces, including zero-weight outcomes
The finite probability-space definition is a restriction agreement, not a renaming
Every function on a finite full-power-set probability space is measurable
Expectation on a finite full-power-set probability space is exactly the published weighted sum
The expectation of an indicator equals the probability of the event
The general inequalities restrict exactly to the published finite statements
The one-variable affine predictor formula is the explicit solution of the normal system when the variance is nonzero, and the constant predictor when it vanishes
